title: Switching failure weight identity
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$. The sum, over all coordinate restrictions for which the restricted function has decision-tree depth at least $k$, of the restriction weights equals the coordinate switching failure probability of $f$ at parameters $\delta$ and $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
